articles.summary: Next-generation MRD test with detection sensitivity across major tumor types at 1 part per million or below Latest innovation from Guardant Health completes a comprehensive portfolio for precision cancer management Guardant Health, Inc. (Nasdaq: GH), a leading precision oncology company, today announced the U.S. clinical launch of Guardant Reveal ® Ultra, a new molecular residual disease (MRD) platform for solid tumors offering personalized, ultra-sensitive detection of residual cancer. Built on Guardant’s Smart Platform, Reveal Ultra incorporates tumor-informed, patient-specific genomic alterations to provide one of the most advanced and actionable views of MRD. Validated on thousands of clinical samples, Guardant Reveal Ultra has demonstrated detection sensitivity of 1 part per million (ppm) or below across major tumor types. The test incorporates patient-specific alterations from thousands of genomic targets spanning all major variant classes, including structural variants.
articles.title: Guardant Health Launches Guardant Reveal® Ultra to Deliver Leading Sensitivity in MRD Testing
